# PrintMeArt

> PrintMeArt is a family-run print studio in 's-Hertogenbosch (Den Bosch), the Netherlands. We sell museum-quality prints of public-domain masterpieces — Van Gogh, Monet, Winslow Homer, Turner, Avercamp, the Dutch Golden Age and more — as giclée prints on fine-art cotton paper or as a Premium Poster photographic print, in many sizes and with an optional white passe-partout. Customers can also upload their own photo or artwork to have it printed.

The shop is available in Dutch (default) and English: every page exists under https://printmeart.nl/nl/ and https://printmeart.nl/en/. Prices include Dutch VAT (btw). We ship within the Netherlands and the EU.

## Shop

- [All art prints](https://printmeart.nl/en/products): the full catalog, filterable by category, artist and museum
- [Artists A–Z](https://printmeart.nl/en/artists): one page per artist with a short biography, key facts, every work we print (year, technique, museum, price) and where the originals hang. Dutch: https://printmeart.nl/nl/kunstenaars
- [Collections](https://printmeart.nl/en/collections): curated collections — museum highlights (Rijksmuseum, The Met, Art Institute of Chicago, …), famous painters, styles and periods, scenes
- [Your design](https://printmeart.nl/en/your-design): print your own photo or artwork
- [Frames](https://printmeart.nl/en/frames): our Natural Oak frame (temporarily unavailable)

Every product page tells the story of the artwork and its artist, and names the museum and credit line it comes from.

## Prices: printing your own photo or artwork

Prices on https://printmeart.nl/en/your-design (November 2026), including Dutch VAT, rolled up in a protective tube. Cotton paper is Hahnemühle Photo Rag (308 g/m²) or Hahnemühle Museum Etching (350 g/m²), same price; Premium Poster is a photographic print on Fujifilm paper (234 g/m²). Professional upscaling for small images: €5. Free shipping in the Netherlands from €75.

| Size (cm) | Premium Poster | Cotton paper |
|---|---|---|
| 13 × 18 | €10.16 | €11.47 |
| 21 × 30 | €13.81 | €17.34 |
| 30 × 40 | €19.08 | €25.79 |
| 40 × 60 | €30.15 | €43.59 |
| 50 × 70 | €40.31 | €59.90 |
| 60 × 90 | €57.84 | €88.07 |
